headline: Do Uber AI Layoffs More American Jobs At Risk?
summary: Uber just cut a chunk of its customer service workforce in the name of AI efficiency, and it is far from alone. The real question is whether these scattered layoffs signal the early edge of a wave that could reshape employment across entire industries.
